turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I still haven't ordered the cake for Saturday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: There's still time if you order today. Chocolate is always popular, or would a fruity one like lemon fit better?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, so where were we with the shopping list?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We still need eggs and bread.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Chloe, do you know the wifi password here? My phone keeps dropping off.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's on the back of the router, I think. The long one with all the letters.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh, I typed that in twice already.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Did you try forgetting the network and joining again? That fixed mine last week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No, I'll try that now. Hold on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Did you decide on the cake flavor?
